endpoints.name: conversation_ai_create_action
endpoints.description: Attach Action to Agent Creates and attach a new action for an AI agent. Actions define specific tasks or behaviors that the agent can perform, such as booking appointments, sending follow-ups, or collecting information. [POST /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions] Scopes: conversation-ai.write.

details.description: Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.

workflowIds.description: Array of workflow IDs to trigger

triggerMessage.description: Optional message to send when triggering the workflow

contactFieldId.description: ID of the contact field in Contacts Table

description.description: Description of the contact field in Contacts Table

contactUpdateExamples.description: Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields. (default: [])

onlySendLink.description: If true, only sends the appointment link without booking

triggerWorkflow.description: Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)

workflowIds.description: Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)

sleepAfterBooking.description: Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)

sleepTimeUnit.description: Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)

sleepTime.description: Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)

transferBot.description: Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)

transferAgent.description: Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)

rescheduleEnabled.description: Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true) (default: false)

cancelEnabled.description: Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true) (default: false)

stopBotDetectionType.description: Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom

stopBotTriggerCondition.description: Condition that triggers stopping the bot

reactivateEnabled.description: Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped

sleepTimeUnit.description: Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

sleepTime.description: Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

enabled.description: Whether this action is enabled for the agent

stopBotExamples.description: Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)

finalMessage.description: Final message sent when stopping the bot

tags.description: Tags to apply when stopping the bot

enabled.description: Whether human handover action is enabled

examples.description: Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)

assignToUserId.description: ID of the user to assign the conversation to

skipAssignToUser.description: Whether to skip assigning to a specific user

createTask.description: Whether to create a task when handing over

reactivateEnabled.description: Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover

sleepTimeUnit.description: Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

sleepTime.description: Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

finalMessage.description: Final message sent when handing over to human

followupSequence.description: Sequence of followup actions to perform

id.description: Unique identifier for this followup step

followupTime.description: Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)

aiEnabledMessage.description: Whether to use AI to generate the followup message (default: true)

triggerWorkflow.description: Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup (default: false)

customMessage.description: Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)

workflowId.description: Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)

contactRequested.description: Whether contact was requested in this followup

dynamicChannelSwitching.description: Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups (default: true)

followUpHours.description: Whether to respect working hours for followups

timezoneToUse.description: Timezone to use for followups, contact or location

transferBotType.description: Type of transfer - Default or Custom

transferToBot.description: ID of the bot/agent to transfer to

enabled.description: Whether this transfer action is enabled

transferBotTriggerCondition.description: Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)

transferBotExamples.description: Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_list_actions
endpoints.description: List Actions for an Agent List for actions for an agent [GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/list] Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_get_action_by_id
endpoints.description: Get Action by ID Retrieves detailed information about a specific action using its unique identifier. Returns the action configuration, associated agents, and performance metrics. [GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}] Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly.

actionId.description: The unique identifier of the action ID Attached to the agent

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_delete_action
endpoints.description: Remove Action from Agent Permanently deletes an action. This will remove the action from all associated agents and cannot be undone. [DELETE /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}] Scopes: conversation-ai.write.

actionId.description: The unique identifier of the action ID Attached to the agent

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_update_followup_settings
endpoints.description: Update Followup Settings Update the followup settings for an action [PATCH /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/followup-settings] Scopes: conversation-ai.write.

dynamicChannelSwitching.description: Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups (default: true)

followUpHours.description: Whether to respect working hours for followups

timezoneToUse.description: Timezone to use for followups, contact or location

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_create_agent
endpoints.description: Create an Agent Creates a new AI agent for the location. The agent will be created with the specified configuration including name, role, actions, and behavior settings. [POST /conversation-ai/agents] Scopes: conversation-ai.write.

businessName.description: Name of the business the agent represents.

mode.description: Mode of operation - OFF, SUGGESTIVE, or AUTO_PILOT (default: "off")

channels.description: Communication channels the agent can operate on

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this agent is a primary agent. (default: false)

waitTime.description: Wait time before agent responds (max 5 for minutes, 300 for seconds) (default: 2)

waitTimeUnit.description: Unit for wait time - SECONDS or MINUTES (default: "seconds")

sleepEnabled.description: Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled. (default: false)

sleepTime.description: Duration of sleep period (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep. (max 2880 for minutes, 172800 for seconds, 48 for hours)

sleepTimeUnit.description: Unit of sleep time - HOURS, MINUTES, or SECONDS (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep.

autoPilotMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention. (max: 100, min: 1) (default: 75)

knowledgeBaseIds.description: Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.

respondToImages.description: Allow agent to respond to images (default: false)

respondToAudio.description: Allow agent to respond to audio (default: false)

sleepOnManualMessage.description: Enable sleep when a manual outbound message is sent.

sleepOnWorkflowMessage.description: Enable sleep when a workflow outbound message is sent.

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_search_agent
endpoints.description: Search Agents Searches for AI agents based on various criteria including name, status, and configuration. Supports advanced filtering and full-text search capabilities. [GET /conversation-ai/agents/search] Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly.

startAfter.description: Start after is the agent id to start after, Serving as skip, send empty when first page

query.description: query to search on agent name, must be provided in lowercase

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_get_agent
endpoints.description: Get Agent Retrieves a specific AI agent by its ID. Returns the complete agent configuration including name, status, actions, and settings. [GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}] Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_update_agent
endpoints.description: Update Agent Updates an existing AI agent's configuration. All fields in the agent configuration can be updated including name, status, actions, and behavior settings. [PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}] Scopes: conversation-ai.write.

businessName.description: Name of the business the agent represents.

mode.description: Mode of operation for the agent, required if primary is enabled.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this agent is a primary agent.

waitTime.description: Wait time before agent responds (max 5 for minutes, 300 for seconds).

waitTimeUnit.description: Unit for wait time - SECONDS or MINUTES

sleepEnabled.description: Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.

sleepTime.description: Duration of sleep period (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep. (max 2880 for minutes, 172800 for seconds, 48 for hours)

sleepTimeUnit.description: Unit of sleep time - HOURS, MINUTES, or SECONDS (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep.

autoPilotMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention. (max: 100, min: 1) (default: 75)

knowledgeBaseIds.description: Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.

respondToImages.description: Allow agent to respond to images (default: false)

respondToAudio.description: Allow agent to respond to audio (default: false)

sleepOnManualMessage.description: Enable sleep when a manual outbound message is sent.

sleepOnWorkflowMessage.description: Enable sleep when a workflow outbound message is sent.

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_delete_agent
endpoints.description: Delete Agent Deletes an AI agent permanently. This action cannot be undone. All associated configurations and conversation history will be removed. [DELETE /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}] Scopes: conversation-ai.write.

endpoints.name: conversation_ai_get_generation_details
endpoints.description: Get the generation details Retrieves detailed information about AI responses including the System Prompt, Conversation history, Knowledge base, website, FAQ chunks, and Rich Text chunks. [GET /conversation-ai/generations] Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly.
